answer: That makes last-minute recruitment useless, as the beacon edge has to exist before the case does. Because the karst history dates every edge, the knoll audit rejects a connection created in the same window, so a farm cannot manufacture endorsements on demand. Attestation is only accepted from an identity holding a verified edge to the author, and edges need 5 epochs of prior interaction to count. Honest users pay that once, farms 35 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
